about_the_game:
Glimpse IDE is a next-generation 3D coding environment built in Unreal Engine. Combined with GlimpseMirror (our VS Code extension), it transforms the way developers understand and traverse code. Instead of relying on flat text editors that were designed for writing rather than reading, Glimpse introduces a visual IDE that turns your workspace into an explorable world.

Focus on writing in your text editor, then jump into Glimpse IDE to see your code. Every file, function, and class becomes part of an immersive environment that mirrors your VS Code setup—complete with your color themes, syntax highlighting, and layout.

While code visualizers and AI tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot have advanced, they still leave a critical gap: human understanding of large codebases. Glimpse IDE bridges that gap by making traversal and comprehension intuitive, fast, and even enjoyable. Whether you’re onboarding a new developer, studying architecture, or exploring a research project, Glimpse turns code exploration into something visual, fluid, and memorable.

Buy once. Own forever. No subscriptions. No battle pass. No gacha. No nonsense.
Just free updates and a single purchase that’s yours to keep forever.

This demo visually showcases code examples from TensorFlow (© Google Inc.), licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (or equivalent 64-bit distribution)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300 (2 cores @ ~3.0 GHz) or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.5 or Vulkan-capable GPU (integrated or dedicated) e.g., Intel UHD 630, AMD Radeon Vega 8, or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or better (integrated GPUs may require reduced settings)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: None
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Runs on integrated and older GPUs at low settings; dynamic resolution supported.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300 (2 cores @ ~3.0 GHz) or better
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12-capable GPU (Feature Level 12_0) e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or AMD Radeon R7 260X (integrated GPUs supported at low settings)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: None
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Runs on integrated and older GPUs at low settings; dynamic resolution supported.

short_description: Open any code folder in VS Code and render the entire folder as a 3d navigable environment with all files in the folder in one view. Edit the code however you like - directly in vs code or using AI code editor tools - and hit Tab to re update the environment.
